threads.body: [Style] `tryExtractRegistryAddressFromDirectory` is just a public wrapper around the private `extractRegistryAddressFromDirectory` with an identical signature. Either rename the existing private method to `tryExtractRegistryAddressFromDirectory` and make it public directly, or inline the public method's body — the indirection adds no value.

[API] Promoting `invocation()` from package-private to `public` adds `org.apache.dubbo.rpc.RpcInvocation` to the public surface of the `library-autoconfigure` module (it's currently only referenced by the package-private `create(...)` factory). Library users will now see and depend on this getter.

If the only reason for the visibility bump is the new caller in `internal.DubboClientNetworkAttributesGetter`, consider keeping `invocation()` package-private and adding a small package-private accessor / helper in this same package (e.g., a method on `DubboRegistryUtil` that takes a `DubboRequest` and reaches the invocation through a package-private bridge), so the public API surface doesn't grow.

[Testing] The `throws ReflectiveOperationException` clause is unused — none of the calls in the test body throw a checked `ReflectiveOperationException` (the reflective field access lives in `setUp()`, not here). Drop the clause.

```suggestion
  void testRegistryModeServerAddress() {
```

[Testing] Per the repository's attribute-assertion convention, the outer `satisfies(AttributeKey, lambda)` parameter should be `val` (not `k`), and the nested parameter should be `v` (not `a`). Existing Dubbo tests (`AbstractDubboTest`, `AbstractDubboTraceChainTest`) already follow this pattern.

```suggestion
                                satisfies(
                                    NETWORK_PEER_ADDRESS,
                                    val -> assertLatestDeps(val, v -> v.isInstanceOf(String.class))),
```

[Testing] Same naming convention — outer parameter should be `val`, nested `v`.

```suggestion
                                satisfies(
                                    NETWORK_PEER_PORT,
                                    val -> assertLatestDeps(val, v -> v.isInstanceOf(Long.class))),
```

[Testing] Outer `satisfies(...)` lambda parameter should be `val` (not `k`).

```suggestion
                                satisfies(NETWORK_PEER_ADDRESS, val -> val.isInstanceOf(String.class)),
                                satisfies(NETWORK_PEER_PORT, val -> val.isInstanceOf(Long.class)))));
```

[Testing] Prefer `hasAttributesSatisfyingExactly(...)` over `hasAttributesSatisfying(...)` here — the exact form catches unexpected attributes, while the non-exact variant silently ignores them. The CLIENT span above already uses the exact form.

[Style] `@SuppressWarnings("all")` is too broad. Narrow it to whatever Error Prone / IntelliJ check you're actually trying to silence on this Mockito-friendly stub (likely `"UnusedVariable"` for the `registry` field).

```suggestion
  @SuppressWarnings("UnusedVariable")
```
